Payment received — you're all set for Siegu Pro

You're moments from unlocking Pro. Grab the app, then activate it with the email you used at checkout. It's a two-minute job.

1

Download Siegu

Pick your platform below and grab the latest build. Every download is free and private — the Pro upgrade doesn't change that.

2

Open Settings → Pro

Launch Siegu, go to Settings → Pro, and enter the email address you used at checkout.

3

Tap “Verify Pro”

Siegu sends a confirmation link to that email. Tap it, and Pro unlocks automatically — reminders, live demo sharing, and all model packs included.
